chunks: And what will make you know what al-Hutama is?

key_terms.الْحُطَمَةُ: The Crusher; a specific name or description of Hellfire that crushes the deeds and bodies of the disbelievers.

ai.seo_question: What is al-Hutama in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-Hutama' is often interpreted not merely as a gate but as a unique, all-consuming fire that crushes the hearts and deeds of the wealthy who hoard resources, reflecting the concept of *Hutam* (crushing). This verse serves as a powerful rhetorical warning against the spiritual bankruptcy of those who prioritize material accumulation over divine accountability, a theme frequently cited by Imams to critique economic injustice.
